subject: general
question: When was National commission for SCs formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2004.**__

 
• National Commission for Scheduled Castes was set up in **2004**. It is a **constitutional body**.
 
• **National Commission for Scheduled Castes works to safeguard the interests of the scheduled castes in India.**
 
• Enquiring into the complaints related to the rights of **SCs**.
 
• NCSC recommends steps to be taken for the betterment of the SCs.
 
• The NCSC reports regularly to the **President of India**.
 
• The NCSC consist of a** chairperson, a vice-chairperson, and three other members.**
